input.rationale: Section 9 ("Warranties") contains only mutual corporate-existence/authority representations (p0056-p0057) and a Globix Agreement acknowledgement (p0058). Nowhere in the Agreement does HDI warrant the quality or conformance of the development or hosting work it performs: there is no professional/workmanlike standard, no conformance-to-specification warranty or period, no compliance-with-laws or malicious-code warranty, and no repair/re-perform/refund remedy (searches for "warrant", "workmanlike", "industry standard", "virus", "AS IS" and "MERCHANTABILITY" return nothing else). Section 1.6 gives only a go-live termination right, which is not a performance warranty. Because there is no express performance warranty at all, the clause fails even the fallback (90 days software / 30 days services with remedies); the only mitigating fact is that there is also no disclaimer, so this is not full walk-away "AS IS" territory. Per the detection guidance, a missing express warranty is a deviation, and we have inserted a new Section 9(c) with the preferred warranty set and a real remedy (re-performance, repair/replacement or refund, plus termination without Termination Payment on failure to cure), noting that a 90-day conformance period is an acceptable fallback.

proposal.summary: Insert HDI performance, conformance, legal-compliance and no-malicious-code warranties with a real remedy into Section 9.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 9 contains only mutual corporate authority warranties, so HDI gives no warranty at all for the development and hosting work it performs. We have added our standard performance and conformance warranty (professional and workmanlike, conformance to the specifications approved under Section 5.2, compliance with laws, no malicious code) with a re-performance, repair/replace or refund remedy. We can discuss shortening the conformance period to ninety (90) days if HDI prefers.

ops.text: (c) HDI represents and warrants to the Company that (1) the design, development, implementation, operation, maintenance, management and hosting of the Site (collectively, the "Services") will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner consistent with industry standards; (2) for a period of twelve (12) months following the Effective Date, the Site will conform in all material respects to the specifications and documentation approved by the Company pursuant to Section 5.2; (3) HDI will perform the Services in compliance with all applicable laws, rules and regulations; and (4) the Site and any software or code delivered or used by HDI in connection with the Services will be free of any virus, worm, disabling device or other malicious code. The Company's remedy for breach of this Section 9(c) shall be, at HDI's option, re-performance, repair or replacement of the non-conforming Services or Site, or a refund of the fees paid or payable to HDI in respect of the non-conforming Services or Site, and if HDI fails to cure such breach within thirty (30) days of written notice from the Company, the Company may terminate this Agreement without penalty and without any Termination Payment.
